## Phase 0 placeholder

This document is scaffolding. It is filled in at **Phase 2**, after the Phase 1
schema checks confirm what the DTF distribution and rate tables actually contain.

Phase 2 will compute, for each of the 18 cities outside New York City that impose
their own sales tax,

$$R_c = \frac{B_c / B_k}{P_c / P_k}$$

— the city's share of its county's taxable sales base relative to its share of
county population — as a three-year mean, and plot the distribution against
Albany's status-quo break-even line of $1.6/1.5 = 1.0667$.
:::
